brief: Members: Seef Properties' nine-month profit fell 30% to BD 2.68m on revenue down 12.7%, which it blames on regional events hitting leisure and spending; the Seef Mall redevelopment continues while the mall trades.
Bahrain: Edamah and Kanoo Real Estate formed a joint venture to develop Pier 1890, a waterfront leisure and commercial destination on an 11,000 sqm site on the Manama Corniche.

Service: the UAE's latest Global Star Rating cycle assessed 179 service channels across 27 federal entities with audits, mystery shoppers and customer feedback; Fujairah's traffic and licensing centre earned the top 7 stars.

AI: Amazon opened its Alexa for Shopping agent to outside merchants, whose products shoppers can find through Alexa and then buy on the merchant's own site, weeks after blocking outside agents from Amazon.

Also new: Waitrose is the first tenant of DMCC's 82,000 sq ft Uptown Place podium (Q1 2028); Fashion House Group will develop an outlet at Grand Uptown Mall, New October City (phase 1 October 2028); and Emaar The Economic City's Q3 loss widened to SAR 241m.

findings.title: Seef Properties' nine-month profit falls 30% to BD 2.68m as regional events weigh on leisure and spending
findings.summary:
Seef Properties reported net profit attributable to shareholders of BD 2.68 million for the nine months to 30 Sep 2026, down 30.0% from BD 3.82 million, on total revenue of BD 9.65 million, down 12.7%; third-quarter profit fell 30.7% to BD 0.77 million on revenue down 12.4% to BD 3.08 million. The company blames regional developments that hit hospitality and entertainment and weighed on consumer spending.

It says the Seef Mall - Seef District redevelopment continues while the mall trades and its Dammam mixed-use project with Majd Investment is progressing.
findings.why: A member mall owner puts filed figures on how the regional security situation is hitting mall leisure and spending in Bahrain.

findings.company: Edamah and Kanoo Real Estate (joint venture)
findings.title: Edamah and Kanoo Real Estate form a joint venture to develop Pier 1890, a waterfront leisure and commercial destination in Manama
findings.summary: Edamah, the real estate arm of Bahrain's sovereign wealth fund Mumtalakat, has formed a joint venture with Kanoo Real Estate to develop Pier 1890, described as a waterfront leisure and commercial destination on the Manama Corniche, on an 11,000 sqm site next to the Shaikh Hamad Causeway. It was announced on the sidelines of Gateway Gulf 2026; no investment, outlet count, operator or opening date was published.
findings.why: A member's new waterfront destination for the Bahrain pipeline, to add once its retail and F&B mix, size and timing are published.

findings.entity: Global Star Rating System for government services
findings.title: UAE's latest government service star ratings cover 179 channels; Fujairah's traffic centre earns the top 7 stars
findings.summary: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid approved and announced on 4 Nov the results of the latest cycle of the Global Star Rating System, which assessed 179 service channels across 27 federal entities on a two-to-seven-star scale using independent audits, mystery shoppers and customer feedback. The Ministry of Interior's Traffic and Licensing Services Centre in Fujairah received 7 stars. The National also reports gains of 13% for call centres, 5% for service centres and 4% for digital channels.
findings.why: It is the UAE's benchmark for public-service quality, built on the mystery shopping, channel audits and customer feedback that MECSC applies in retail.

findings.entity: Alexa for Shopping, Shop Direct Merchant Workspace
findings.title: Amazon opens its Alexa for Shopping agent to outside merchants through a Shop Direct workspace
findings.summary: Amazon has added a Shop Direct Merchant Workspace that lets eligible merchants register, link their online store and submit product feeds so their products can be found through Alexa for Shopping and Amazon's website and app; shoppers tap 'Shop Direct' and finish the purchase on the merchant's own site. Andy Jassy told analysts that Alexa for Shopping 'is going to be the primary shopping agent customers use to shop Amazon'. Regions and start date were not given.
findings.why: Amazon, which blocked outside AI shopping agents in October, is now drawing outside retailers into its own agent, a model Gulf retailers on Amazon.ae, Amazon.sa and Amazon.eg should watch.

findings.title: Waitrose signs as the first retail tenant of DMCC's Uptown Place, due in Q1 2028
findings.summary: DMCC has signed Spinneys to open a Waitrose store of over 5,000 sq ft, a smaller format with a food-to-go deli, at Uptown Place in Uptown Dubai. It is the first confirmed tenant of the scheme's 82,000 sq ft of retail space across 18 units, alongside more than 560,000 sq ft of Grade A offices in two towers and 1,600 parking spaces; Uptown Place is expected to open in Q1 2028.
findings.why: A grocery-anchored retail podium in a Dubai business district, a small pipeline entry and an example of convenience retail built into office schemes.

findings.company: Uptown 6 October for Development and Investment; Fashion House Group (UK)
findings.title: Fashion House Group to develop and run an international outlet at Grand Uptown Mall, New October City, from October 2028
findings.summary: Uptown 6 October for Development and Investment has signed a memorandum under which UK-based Fashion House Group will develop and operate an international outlet at Grand Uptown Mall in New October City, with Emtelak Real Estate Investment Fund as strategic partner. The scheme, billed as North Africa's first integrated outlet destination, adds a boutique hotel, cinema, restaurants and an e-commerce platform with click and collect; phase 1 is scheduled for October 2028, subject to designs and approvals. Daily News Egypt reports an investment of over EGP 6bn and about 90,000 sqm of leasable space, figures no second source confirms yet.
findings.why: Egypt's first planned outlet destination with an international outlet operator, and a new pipeline lead for the 2027 Directory.

findings.title: Emaar The Economic City's Q3 loss widens to SAR 241m as revenue falls 59.5%
findings.summary: Emaar The Economic City, developer of King Abdullah Economic City, posted a Q3 2026 net loss of SAR 241 million against SAR 135 million a year earlier, as revenue fell 59.5% to SAR 145 million, according to Argaam's report of its filing. The nine-month loss widened 26.5% to SAR 444 million on revenue down 37.0% to SAR 429 million, mainly on lower project revenue, higher legal provisions and a one-off financing gain in 2025, partly offset by lower financing costs and a gain on selling investment properties.
findings.why: The sharp fall in project revenue at King Abdullah Economic City's developer belongs in the Q3 results picture ahead of RCM Jeddah (7 to 8 Dec).

watch.item: Saudi security situation: flights, events and mall trading
watch.note: King Khalid International, Riyadh, resumed operations on 17 Oct after the 10 Oct attack, with each flight still needing GACA permission (Gulf Business, 20 Oct). Suspensions reported on 20 Oct: Etihad Riyadh and Dammam, Air India and IndiGo to 24 Oct; Akasa Air to 27 Oct; Air France-KLM Riyadh to 7 Nov; Lufthansa Group to 18 Nov; Philippine Airlines to 29 Nov; Cathay Pacific to 31 Jan 2027; Delta's Atlanta-Riyadh flights to March 2027; Qatar Airways' Riyadh and Dammam flights and Gulf Air's Riyadh services have no restart date. Malaysia Airlines resumed Jeddah and Madinah on 18 Oct. FII10, the Saudi Retail Forum and Intersec Saudi Arabia have moved to 2027 and Riyadh Fashion Week was postponed on 14 Oct (Arab News). Kingdom Centre has moved its office tenants to remote working while its mall stays open (AFP, 18 Oct). Riyadh Season was due to open on 21 Oct; no dated report of the opening had been found by 2 Nov.
